findings.highlight: she told me to run to the church
findings.governingReading: she had said whatever she pleased: that I could not fight without Saber, and should flee to the church
findings.explanation: The English collapses Rin’s two-part barrage and omits Shirou’s irritated framing.

findings.evidenceJa: それまで一度も寄りつかなかった
findings.governingReading: I had never gone near it before
findings.explanation: The English uses an ungrammatical past participle in the comparison.

findings.highlight: The church took care of all the orphans
findings.evidenceJa: 孤児になった子供たちを預かっていた教会
findings.governingReading: the church had taken in children orphaned by the fire
findings.explanation: Unsupported “all” broadens the church’s custodial history.
The pain’s sharp, piercing quality disappears.
The narration’s unexplained sensation is prematurely defined as conviction.
The hidden stair’s architectural location is changed.

findings.highlight: I don’t have enough energy to just stand here and think
findings.evidenceJa: 悠長に思案しているほど、こっちにも余裕はない
findings.governingReading: I cannot afford to deliberate at leisure
findings.explanation: Urgency and lack of time become physical lack of energy.
The stealth action changes from suppressing breath to continuing to breathe quietly.
The destination is mislabeled as burial chambers.
